# Topology publication fixture provenance — `lowering/v2`

Generated by the producer's own code at the exact bound revision — not
hand-written and not edited after generation.

## Why this exists beside `topology_publication`

The fixture next door is `lowering/v1`, and it stays. The producer has since
moved to `lowering/v2`, which carries an edge's direction and properties into
the intent as structured data rather than only inside the human `content`
string. That is a different durable write for the same fact, keyed differently
on purpose, and this repository declares support for **both** contract versions
in `SUPPORTED_LOWERING_CONTRACTS`.

A single fixture regenerated in place would have replaced the qualification of
one supported version with the qualification of the other, leaving a version
this repository claims to accept exercised by nothing. A superseded contract is
not an unsupported one; both are asserted here for as long as both are declared.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Producer repository | Quantum-L9/l9-constellation-topology |
| Producer revision | 2db4ce6b2fc47c5bb07864fa5d702e0989509806 |
| Generator inputs | tests/fixtures/repository_model_packets/{l9-gate-sdk,l9-mcp-server,l9-assertion-sample} |
| Compile / publish time | 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z (fixed, deterministic) |
| Pipeline | compile_topology -> load_publication_policy -> build_publication_plan -> build_topology_bundle_artifacts + build_publication_plan_artifacts |
| Plan contract | l9.topology-publication-plan 1.0.0 |
| Lowering contract | lowering/v2 |
| Plan id | publication-plan:4ac866aff78288d1f7ec552cf5c191f5eb8b97e39f42dd596656c741f8e50a81 |
| Candidates | 73 eligible / 3 held / 40 skipped |

Both bundles are integrity-bound: every file listed in each `manifest.json`
carries its sha256 content hash and size, which the adapter under test
re-verifies. Regenerate only from the producer repository at a recorded
revision; never edit these files by hand.
